{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Attendant}}
[[File:PampySupi-SWFB.png|thumb|right|200px|Twi'lek senatorial aides [[Pampy/Legends|Pampy]] and [[Supi/Legends|Supi]].]]
An '''aide''' or '''assistant''' was someone who assisted a person of high political position. They were usually close friends with their superior, and were appointed personally by them. An aide also could be assigned to assist a high ranking military officer, such as a [[General/Legends|general]] or [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]].

[[Opdoa]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] with the [[Goa-Ato/Legends|Goa-Ato]] guild on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], worked with the [[Guild Assignments Group]] under the title "Assistant."<ref name="New Assignments">{{WEGCite|story=New Assignments|book=Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide}}</ref>
